subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should existing project `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files larger than 1 MiB be silently excluded from session context by default?
rationale: This is a compatibility and agent-behavior policy change, not merely an implementation detail: current main loads readable context files without this size threshold.

options.title: Preserve existing context behavior
options.body: Apply the bounded-reader repair to explicit prompt-input files and retain current project-context loading until a separately designed compatibility path exists.

options.title: Adopt the 1 MiB context cap
options.body: Approve the cap as a deliberate compatibility change, with a clear warning and focused fresh-install and upgrade behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing context behavior
recommendation.body: Apply the bounded-reader repair to explicit prompt-input files and retain current project-context loading until a separately designed compatibility path exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed boundary and can incorporate the selected direction, while current-main history did not yield a higher-confidence area owner in this review environment.
